description: This file defines a Subscriptions class for managing user subscriptions, including actions like cancel, pause, resume, refund, and retrieving transaction data. It also includes related type definitions and utility functions.

classes.name: Subscriptions
classes.description: Class providing methods to manage user subscriptions, including cancel, pause, resume, refund, and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a user subscription, choosing endpoint based on legacy status.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses a user subscription, with different HTTP methods for legacy and current.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a subscription, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: transactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history, distinguishing between legacy (v1) and current (v2).

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Fetches invoice URL for a specific transaction.

methods.name: updateUrl
methods.description: Gets URL for updating payment method, varies for legacy and current subscriptions.

methods.name: checkoutUrl
methods.description: Generates checkout URL for a given plan and period.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Changes the subscription to a different product.
